summary: A short cover note from BBN attaching a map of the ARPANET as of the end of December 1972. The ovals show which host computers were thought to connect to each IMP, and sites were asked to report errors or changes. The map itself was a drawing and is not part of the text.

eli5.summary: A map of the early network showing which computers plugged into which gateway boxes, with a request to tell the mapmaker if anything was wrong.
